data.what_it_does: This plugin checks if a device has an autostart settings activity and can open it. It also supports opening battery‑saver settings to prevent background killing.
use_when: You need to direct users to enable autostart for your app
You want to ensure background tasks survive device reboot
You support a wide range of Android manufacturers
avoid_when: You target iOS or other platforms
You already handle battery optimizations via permission_handler alone
weaknesses: Does not handle iOS or web
data.setup_notes: Add dependency to pubspec, import package, call AutostartSettings.canOpen / open
